data.name: Dimpi
data.gender_notes: Dimpi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dimpi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dimpana', which refers to the loving form of the goddess Durga. In Hindu mythology, Durga is considered the mother of the universe and the protector of all beings. The name Dimpi signifies the deep devotion and love one has for the divine mother. The name Dimpi carries the meaning “Goddess Durga's loving form” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dimpi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess durga's loving form and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of love and devotion towards the divine mother.
data.etymology: Dimpi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Durga's loving form.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dimpi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
